entries.title: ANEVUM public platform rebuilt around the system portfolio
entries.dek: The public site moved from an experimental dashboard toward a product, research, evidence, and founder platform.
body: The public information architecture now treats IREN, RHEN, NOSTRA, GRAEN, and VELUM as distinct systems with separate responsibilities, evidence boundaries, and product surfaces.

The release added a professional product portfolio, dedicated system pages, separate equities and crypto performance records, a research hub, founder profile, recruiter-facing resume, deterministic PDF resume, route metadata, responsive browser verification, and stricter public-data assertions.
The monthly seasonal layer remains independent of the product architecture. October's treatment can change the atmosphere without changing the underlying information system.

entries.title: Crypto became an explicit market lane rather than an equities clone
entries.dek: The architecture now keeps continuously traded crypto evidence separate from the equities population.
body: Crypto research and execution state are attributed to an explicit market lane so features, evidence, calibration, replay, and performance are not silently pooled with equities.
NOSTRA, GRAEN, ADS, and VELUM each have crypto-facing research responsibilities, while RHEN retains execution and risk authority.
Public live performance remains empty until real closed live crypto trades exist. Replay, paper, shadow, and development evidence are not substituted for a live sample.

entries.title: Prediction-to-outcome attribution was hardened
entries.dek: Candidate prediction state is retained before execution and can later receive post-event forward outcomes.
body: The evidence pipeline preserves pre-trade research state separately from the eventual realized outcome. That prevents later information from rewriting what the system actually knew at decision time.
Direct attribution links candidate evaluation, signal, intent, order, position, and forward outcomes through canonical telemetry.
This work changes evidence quality, not strategy thresholds, live risk, position sizing, or broker behavior.

entries.title: Selection bias became a first-class research problem
entries.dek: GRAEN formalized how repeated strategy search can make weak effects look stronger than they are.
body: The research program now treats selection, multiplicity, dependence, and adaptive reuse of evidence as explicit failure modes.
The working framework separates discovery evidence from validation evidence and requires claims to stay inside the strength of the available sample.
The objective is not to eliminate exploration. It is to make the cost of exploration visible before a research result can influence production.

entries.title: VELUM established a broker-isolated replay path
entries.dek: Historical reconstruction and counterfactual work can reuse research mathematics without gaining live broker authority.
body: VELUM reconstructs historical market state, applies declared friction assumptions, replays bounded strategy logic, and records comparable outcomes.
The replay path is intentionally isolated from live broker execution. Simulated results remain research evidence and never enter the live performance record.
The system supports off-hours research and is being extended across both equities and continuously traded crypto data.

entries.title: RHEN production hardening completed after the Railway scaling upgrade
entries.dek: Runtime services, research scheduling, readiness checks, persistence, and operational notifications were verified together.
body: The live trader, Research Agent, scheduler, and pre-open service were checked on the upgraded Railway environment with bounded restart behavior, health checks, persistence, and alerting intact.
The goal was operational resilience rather than a strategy rewrite. Live trading logic remained protected while support services became easier to observe and maintain.
Slack remains the operational alert surface for failures, blockers, state changes, and intervention-worthy events.

entries.title: First official RHEN live session closed with a complete evidence trail
entries.dek: The important milestone was not a return number; it was a reproducible live record.
body: RHEN completed an official live operating session and reconciled broker truth back into the canonical ledger.
The public record uses normalized percentages and counts rather than raw account values. External cash flow is separated from strategy performance through explicit performance epochs.
Post-close research remained evidence-driven: small samples were not treated as justification for on-the-fly threshold changes.

entries.title: Calendar-driven seasonal presentation became part of the public system
entries.dek: Seasonal identity now changes the atmosphere without becoming the information architecture.
body: ANEVUM gained a calendar-driven theme layer, ambient effects, and reusable seasonal tokens.
The product hierarchy, evidence surfaces, and accessibility rules remain stable while the visual treatment can rotate month by month.
The October treatment uses restrained warm spectral accents rather than turning the product interface into a novelty skin.
